title: BatchPublishResponse
description: Success response from POST /articles:batch: one result per input item, in input order. The HTTP status is 201 when any item was created and 200 when every item was deduplicated. On a failed validation the server instead returns an application/problem+json document carrying a per-item error list (index and code) and writes nothing, so this success shape is never partial.

results.description: One entry per submitted article, in the order received.

index.description: Zero-based position of the item in the request.

status.description: created for a brand-new article; deduplicated for an idempotent replay or a content-hash duplicate.
